summary: Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC filed an 8-K to report the entry into a Junior Subordinated Indenture and issuance of €850 million 4.55% Junior Subordinated Notes due 2056. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. Proceeds of approximately €839.8 million ($974.3 million at spot) will be used for general corporate purposes, including repaying commercial paper. The notes feature an initial fixed rate, a cross-currency swap converting to fixed USD (5.98535%), and step-up margins after reset dates. No special-situations event, stake, premium, or board recommendation exists.
